votes.reason: The implementation removes account copies, minimises retained invoices, audits erasure, and purges expired erased invoices while preserving live invoices.

limitations: the brief describes the ledger and the Git delta only; RingFrame runs none of the project's commands
plain prompts are counted, never stored; changes no Ask explains may follow an unrecorded instruction
no tool facts were recorded; the result of a command cannot be judged
the verdict is a judgement by sub-agents over bounded evidence; agreement is its confidence, nothing here is certain
